sourceConclusions: Only the existing opt-in preview TOC grant can accept task-local identity change; Host binds exact owner/source/task/revision/deadline and rechecks after actor hop before ACK. No BookStore or body-cache grant is minted.

Grant initialBookURL remains its durable reference until a sealed successful TOC result; current bookURL changes only on its internal synchronized capability. Host removes existing entity and TOC leases, and snapshots bind bookURL as well as revision/hash.

URL-scoped large variables/chapter maps/original TOC are stored only inside the same record alternateURLState, keyed by exact UTF8 URL. The global small map follows original reGetBook RAM behavior. No new-URL data is copied from the old large-variable bucket or another book record.

Successful finish validates current grant URL and only a TOC result can swap active URL state; identityBookURL anchors the original record ID and new ContextReference points at the same ID/new URL. Failed/cancelled business leaves durable book URL unchanged while accepted state writes remain factual.

TOCPackage carries the actual new optional bookURL. BookStore validates its old App UUID/source/URL and chapter metadata CAS before committing the new bookInfoURL; sourceChanged participates in saveMeta. It does not replace the stored UUID or reading position.

Root known fixes are present: read/commit chapter lookup filters current book URL, empty/null small maps compare by contents, and Host ACK rechecks active grant/cancellation. No confirmed additional blocker found in this source pass.
